questions.text: Muffins come in boxes of 6 and cookies in boxes of 8. Asha wants to buy the same number of muffins and cookies in full boxes. What is the smallest number of each she can buy?

questions.explanation: We need the LCM of 6 and 8. Multiples of 8: 8, 16, 24 … and 24 is also a multiple of 6. So LCM = 24.
questions.explanationHi: 6 और 8 का ल.स.प. चाहिए। 8 के गुणज: 8, 16, 24 … और 24, 6 का भी गुणज है। अतः ल.स.प. = 24।

questions.explanation: We need the HCF of 36 and 48. 36 = 12 × 3 and 48 = 12 × 4, so HCF = 12.

It is called the Red Fort because its huge walls are made of red sandstone. We entered through the Lahori Gate and walked through a covered market called Chhatta Chowk. Then we saw the Diwan-i-Aam, where the emperor met common people, and the Diwan-i-Khas, where he met important guests. Mrs. Kapoor explained that every year on Independence Day, the Prime Minister hoists the national flag at the Red Fort and speaks to the nation. In the evening, we watched a light and sound show about its history. We were tired but happy, and we promised to always keep our monuments clean.
